delivery.title: Learning & support
delivery.lead: Three common paths around the Source Available release: self-study, feedback, and commercial licensing enquiries.

license.title: Non-commercial study
license.body: Read, run and modify the source free of charge for personal learning, academic research and classroom teaching.

implement.title: Feedback & contributions
implement.body: Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening an issue or PR; contributions are licensed under the same terms.

custom.title: Commercial licensing
custom.body: Enterprise deployment, client delivery and SaaS require a separate written licence from the copyright holder.

out.title: Expressly outside the licence
items: Production deployment or processing real business data (including internal use)
Delivering products, components, scaffolds or foundations to third parties
Providing SaaS, hosting, consulting or paid implementation services
Removing attribution, misusing trademarks or sublicensing
